methodologyNotes: Roster of eight real, US-market washing machine lines (2020-2024) independently re-verified against official manufacturer pages (LG USA, Samsung US, Whirlpool, Maytag, Speed Queen, Bosch US, GE Appliances, Electrolux) and reputable retailers (Lowe's, Home Depot, Best Buy, Abt, AJ Madison, Town Appliance, US Appliance, Warner's Stellian, Designer Appliances, Homery). Capacity is US DOE-rated cubic feet; max_spin_rpm is the published maximum per spec sheet; booleans are true only when explicitly confirmed, false when explicitly denied, null when unconfirmable. priceUsd reflects published US MSRP / regular list price for the exact model/config. Release years are set only when corroborated by a manufacturer spec PDF or support metadata; otherwise null (a null beats a guess). All accessedAt and generatedAt are 2026-06-15.
